materials.title: Timber & Finishes
materials.sub: Sustainably sourced, kiln-dried hardwoods crafted to last generations.
materials.walnutDesc: A premium dark wood with rich chocolate tones and beautiful wavy grain patterns. It is highly valued for its natural elegance and smooth finish.
materials.walnutProperties: Moderately hard, excellent shock resistance, highly stable.
materials.walnutUses: Dining tables, premium sideboards, accent furniture.
materials.teakDesc: Famous for its incredible natural oil content, Teak offers unmatched moisture resistance and durability. It ages to a beautiful golden-brown color.
materials.teakProperties: Extremely durable, weather-resistant, naturally oily, resists termites.
materials.teakUses: Bespoke pivot doors, outdoor dining, luxury cladding.
materials.oakDesc: The classic carpentry hardwood. Known for its strong grain lines, immense strength, and classic golden hue. It handles daily wear better than almost any wood.
materials.oakProperties: Very hard, highly wear-resistant, prominent open grain.
materials.oakUses: Dining tables, bench seating, architectural doors.
materials.mapleSub: Light color, high density, modern look
materials.mapleDesc: A dense, heavy wood with a light cream color and subtle grain. It offers a bright, clean, minimalist aesthetic suitable for modern spaces.
materials.mapleProperties: Extremely hard, scratch-resistant, uniform fine texture.
materials.mapleUses: Custom shelving, modern cabinets, heavy-use worktops.
materials.cherryDesc: Renowned for its smooth texture and warm reddish-brown hue that deepens and grows richer when exposed to light over time.
materials.cherryProperties: Medium density, excellent flexibility, smooth closed grain.
materials.cherryUses: Fine cabinetry, custom shelving, bedroom furniture.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.sub: Answers to common questions about our custom commissions.
faq.q1: What is the standard lead time for a bespoke build?
faq.a1: Our standard lead time is 4 to 6 weeks. This includes wood sourcing, kiln-drying check, crafting, hand-finishing, and installation in your space.
faq.q2: Do you deliver and install across the UAE?
faq.a2: Yes, we provide professional delivery and white-glove installation across all seven Emirates (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, etc.) included in your quote.
faq.q3: Can I visit the workshop to see my project?
faq.a3: Absolutely! We love welcoming clients to our Dubai workshop by appointment to inspect the timber selection and watch the progress of their build.
faq.q4: How does solid wood behave in Dubai's high humidity?
faq.a4: All our timber is kiln-dried to 8-10% moisture content. We design expansion joints and use premium finishes to prevent warping under seasonal humidity changes.
faq.q5: Can I request a custom timber not listed?
faq.a5: Yes. Through our international lumber suppliers, we can source specialty slabs, exotic hardwoods, or live-edge slabs of custom dimensions.

process.title: Our Crafting Process
process.sub: How we turn raw timber into heirloom furniture.
process.step1Desc: Configure your specifications online or share inspiration drawings. We discuss details and provide a transparent quote within 24 hours.
process.step2Desc: For doors and architectural fittings, our team visits your space for laser measurements and provides a detailed 3D design drawing.
process.step3Desc: Our experienced joiners hand-select each lumber board for matching grain and craft your piece using traditional woodworking joinery.
process.step4Desc: We apply food-safe oils and organic waxes for protection, deliver it to your home, and install it with a decade-backed warranty.

about.lead: Pacific Carpentry is a Dubai-based workshop crafting furniture and architectural woodwork for homes, designers and businesses across the region.
about.b1: Every joint is considered. We favour traditional joinery, solid timber and finishes that age gracefully — no veneers, no shortcuts.
about.b2: We source sustainably certified hardwoods and finish them with low-VOC, food-safe oils and waxes.
about.b3: Made to order, built to last, and backed for a decade. If it carries our mark, it's made to be handed down.
